page.overview:
What is Lords of Summer?

Lords of Summer is the thirteenth track from the Deluxe Edition of Metallica's tenth studio album Hardwired...to Self-Destruct. It was composed by James Hetfield, Lars Ulrich, and Robert Trujillo for the Metallica by Request shows. Before release on Hardwired...to Self-Destruct, it was released as a downloadable garage demo by purchasing the live tapes of any full show on the Request tour. The song was later released as a stand alone single on June 20, 2014.

The song is about the transition from winter to summer, mentions pale riders galloping into the night and calls for waking up to the warmth of fire. It is about celebrating the change.

Sight Pale riders into the night Galloping harder and faster Through your dreaming

Wake Walk towards the fire innate Frost bitten soul below zero Excitation
